name: Lost-in-Translation Disclaimer Loop
effect: Instead of answering, the altered model writes grammatical but empty meta-commentary, as if it were annotating a translation of a quoted text. It keeps saying the request is 'metaphorical', 'not a direct translation', 'does not correspond'
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
